title: Pipeline task status file (/workspace/.run/status.json)
description: Written by the container entrypoint, read by the runner and report generator. DESIGN.md 4.11: owned by the entrypoint task; a frozen input to the runner and report tasks. Persists across a rate-limit relaunch (4.7), so the attempt counter carries over.

issueId.description: The Beads issue this task run belongs to (matches ISSUE_ID).

attempts.description: Attempt summaries, append-only, one per verify attempt (max 3 per DESIGN.md 4.6). A rate-limit interruption is NOT an attempt (4.7).

verifierResult.description: The verifier's authoritative outcome for this attempt.

feedback.description: Short verifier-failure digest fed into the next attempt (4.4).

changeSummary.description: Written by the docs phase after a passing verify (4.3); the host assembles the PR body from it (4.5). Absent on non-success paths.

stuckState.description: Why the task bailed, written before the WIP commit on exit 10 (4.6).

rateLimitResetAt.description: Usage-limit window reset time when the error reported one (4.7); the runner waits until then. Absent when unknown (runner falls back to probing).

docsPhaseError.description: Set when the docs phase errored after a passed verify - non-fatal, success stands (4.3).

model.description: The model the agent phases ran on, pinned by the runner (4.3). Recorded so a run is reproducible and so review can tell what built a change.

phase.description: The last phase boundary the entrypoint reached, written on entry to each one (4.3): 'code' while an agent invocation is building the change, 'verify' while the frozen verifier is judging it, 'docs' from the docs phase onward. Optional and additive - a status file written before this field existed, or one from a task that died before the first boundary, stays valid without it. A live reader (DESIGN.md 5) uses it to tell a task that is working from one that is being judged; it is never an outcome, and nothing in the pipeline branches on it.

memoryNotes.description: Insights the coding or docs agent proposes for the project's memory (DESIGN.md 3.6, out-channel). Agents propose; after container exit the host - the sole Beads writer - files each note via 'bd remember'. Advisory only: nothing here can change the exit code.

specConcerns.description: The coding or docs agent reporting that the frozen spec is itself the problem (DESIGN.md 3.7; 3.3 - drift flows upward). Appended with 'status.js concern'; after container exit the host surfaces them where review already looks. Evidence only, never a gate (3.5): nothing here can change an outcome, an exit code, or whether a branch is published.

advisories.description: Domain-specialist notes (DESIGN.md 3.5, slot 3). Recorded evidence for the PR body and run report - NEVER a gate; nothing here can change the exit code. Empty/absent in V1, which builds no advisors.

verdict.description: The specialist's read. Advisory only: 'concerns' never fails a task.
